channel.title: Ruslan's Gadget Corner
channel.description: phones, ADSL, gadgets and everything with a battery

item.title: Leaving the shop
item.description: After four years I am leaving the phone shop. I got a job at a repair centre, real repairs with a soldering iron, not only selling covers. I don't think I will write here a lot more. Everybody reads things on the phone now and the phone does not like long posts. Thanks for all your questions. And…

item.title: My first smartphone
item.description: I finally bought one for myself. It has apps, a map, a browser that shows real websites. I read this blog on it right now. The theme looks small but it works. The future is here and it is in my pocket and it needs charging every night.

item.title: Why your phone says "No network" in the mountains
item.description: Every summer people come back from the jailoo angry that the phone did not work. It is not the phone. There are no towers on the summer pastures, the sheep don't pay for SIM cards. Climb a hill and stand still. That is the official advice of Ruslan's Gadget Corner.

item.title: Touch screens are coming
item.description: The first touch-screen phones arrived at the shop. Customers poke them like a hot stove. One grandmother asked where the buttons are and when I showed her she said "and when it breaks?". Good question, apa. [photo: bazaar | The phone row at the bazaar, where the cheaper ones come from.]

item.title: Charging your phone without electricity
item.description: Many people come to the shop now asking how to keep the phone alive with the power limits. My advice: Turn off Bluetooth. Nobody is sending you anything. Bring the charger to work, school, the internet club, anywhere with a generator. Car chargers work. If you have a car. If you have petrol. We…

item.title: ADSL at home: one month
item.description: I got ADSL at home from Attelkom! One month report: Speed: in the morning very fast. In the evening when everybody comes home, like dial-up with ambitions. No more modem noise at night, my mother is very happy. I can download a 4 MB music clip in two minutes. TWO MINUTES. Verdict: 9/10. Minus 1…

item.title: Review: the Nokia with the slide
item.description: Came to our shop on Thursday, three pieces. It slides up to show the keys and makes a very satisfying click. Camera 2 megapixels, which is enough to photograph your plov and your cousin. Battery: two days if you don't play Snake. Price at our shop: I can't write it here, the boss says. Come and…

item.title: Hello Kündölük 2.0!
item.description: New Kündölük is here and it has tags, photo albums and this beautiful glossy theme. Jaltyrak means shiny and it is SHINY. It even has the orange RSS button. I don't know what RSS is but I have the button. The plan: one post a week about phones and gadgets that you can actually buy in Talas.
